verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe scheduling recurring runs (morning PR reviews, overnight CI analysis, weekly audits), CI/CD integration via GitHub Actions/GitLab, MCP-driven event channels (Telegram/Discord/webhooks) that trigger sessions while away, and long-running cloud/background tasks checked on later — all core to autonomous background automation. Community evidence doesn't directly dispute this specific capability, though general reliability complaints suggest some caveats on trustworthiness of unsupervised runs.
